boundedBinaryLiteralChecks.scope: Exact ASCII literals only; not native absence proof.

limitations: Same-slot matrix replacement is exact UI/skill selection evidence, not base-animation or enhanced-skill inheritance.
TargetSkillID in SkillLevel grants identifies the granted active; unrelated interrupt conditions/cooldown resets do not identify its animation.
No Style/Wave/SkillCode/alias field found in these exact blocked entries does not prove absence in all modules/versions.
